analysis.overall: You spent 84% of your day in target range with an impressively flat overnight curve, though a couple of daytime low dips and a steep morning spike after breakfast required extra attention.

events.title: Early afternoon low drop
events.description: Glucose gradually drifted down to a low of 58 mg/dL before you treated with 40g of carbs at 2:03 PM, swiftly bringing your numbers back up.

events.title: Pre-dinner dip
events.description: Active insulin from earlier micro-corrections pushed levels down to 63 mg/dL before stabilizing into the evening.

events.title: Dinner and smooth recovery
events.description: Eating 40g of carbs with a 2.2u meal bolus brought your readings out of a low baseline and set up a steady start to the night.

events.title: Exceptionally flat overnight
events.description: Your sensor recorded a beautifully stable line between 80 and 115 mg/dL for nearly five straight hours while you slept.

events.title: Post-breakfast sandwich spike
events.description: A 32g cheese veg sandwich caused a fast climb to a peak of 262 mg/dL by 10:10 AM, which is now coming down after multiple stacked correction doses.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Consider giving your breakfast bolus a bit more pre-bolus time to absorb before eating carbs like sandwiches to curb steep morning spikes.
